f.title: Sponsor: select capable sites and investigators and fulfil risk management duties
f.statement: Clinical trial sponsors shall select clinical trial institutions and investigators with the appropriate capability, and fulfil responsibilities including subject protection, management of investigational drugs, clinical trial data management and risk management.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor (药物临床试验申办者)
rows.quote: 药物临床试验申办者应当选择具备相应能力的药物临床试验机构和研究者，并履行受试者保护、临床试验用药品管理、临床试验数据管理、风险管理等责任。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: Drug clinical trial sponsors shall select drug clinical trial institutions and investigators with corresponding capabilities, and fulfil responsibilities such as subject protection, management of investigational drugs, clinical trial data management and risk management.

f.title: Apply to switch an OTC drug to prescription status when ADR data show it is unsuitable
f.statement: Where the MAH of a registered non-prescription drug considers, based on adverse reaction monitoring and post-marketing evaluation results, that the drug is no longer suitable for non-prescription management, it shall apply to NMPA to switch it to a prescription drug.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026. Registered non-prescription (OTC) drugs.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 已注册的非处方药，药品上市许可持有人根据不良反应监测和上市后评价结果认为不适宜作为非处方药管理的，应当向国务院药品监督管理部门申请转换为处方药。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. NMPA may also switch OTC to prescription on its own evaluation (Art 18(3)).
rows.quote_en: For registered non-prescription drugs, where the drug marketing authorisation holder, based on the results of adverse reaction monitoring and post-marketing evaluation, considers it unsuitable for management as a non-prescription drug, it shall apply to the drug regulatory department under the State Council for conversion to a prescription drug.

f.title: Comply with GVP and maintain a pharmacovigilance system with risk identification, assessment and control
f.statement: MAHs shall comply with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), establish and improve a pharmacovigilance system, monitor adverse drug reactions and other harmful reactions related to drug use, and establish mechanisms for risk identification, assessment and control. GVP is issued by NMPA.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.systems: Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (药物警戒质量管理规范)
f.processes: Safety governance; Signal management; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当遵守药物警戒质量管理规范，建立健全药物警戒体系，对药品不良反应及其他与用药有关的有害反应进行监测，建立风险识别、评估和控制机制。
systems: Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (药物警戒质量管理规范)
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. New explicit GVP-compliance duty in the regulations; GVP itself is issued by NMPA (Art 24(2)). legal_basis: DAL Art 12(2) is the parent provision (not cited by the text itself).
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall comply with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practice, establish and improve the pharmacovigilance system, monitor adverse drug reactions and other harmful reactions related to drug use, and establish mechanisms for risk identification, assessment and control.

f.title: Distributors: cooperate with the MAH's pharmacovigilance work
f.statement: Drug distributors (and medical institutions) shall cooperate with MAHs in carrying out pharmacovigilance work.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.processes: Partner & vendor oversight; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Drug distributor (药品经营企业); also medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品经营企业、医疗机构应当配合药品上市许可持有人开展药物警戒工作。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: Drug distributors and medical institutions shall cooperate with drug marketing authorisation holders in carrying out pharmacovigilance work.

f.title: Domestic legal entity of an overseas MAH: have quality and risk control capability and be named in the insert
f.statement: Where the MAH is an overseas company, the domestic legal entity it designates under DAL Art 38 shall have corresponding quality management and risk control capability, set up the corresponding management department and staff it; information on the designated domestic legal entity shall be stated in the package insert.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026. Overseas MAHs.

rows.actor: Domestic legal entity designated by an overseas MAH
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人为境外企业的，其依照药品管理法第三十八条规定指定的中国境内企业法人应当具备相应的质量管理能力和风险控制能力，设立相应的管理部门、配备相应的人员；被指定的中国境内企业法人的相关信息应当在药品说明书中载明。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: Where the drug marketing authorisation holder is an overseas enterprise, the domestic enterprise legal person in China designated by it in accordance with Article 38 of the Drug Administration Law shall have corresponding quality management capability and risk control capability, set up corresponding management departments and assign corresponding personnel; relevant information on the designated domestic enterprise legal person shall be stated in the package insert.

f.title: Continuously examine the quality, efficacy and adverse reactions of registered drugs
f.statement: MAHs shall continuously examine the quality, efficacy and adverse reactions of registered drugs.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.exceptions: If the MAH fails to do so, the registration certificate is not renewed on expiry (Art 28(3)).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当持续考察已注册药品的质量、疗效和不良反应。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall continuously examine the quality, efficacy and adverse reactions of registered drugs.

f.title: Conduct periodic post-marketing evaluation and act on its results
f.statement: MAHs shall periodically carry out post-marketing evaluation of registered drugs, comprehensively analysing and assessing their risks and benefits, and, based on the results, take measures such as revising the package insert, raising quality standards, improving the manufacturing process, suspending production and sale, recalling the drug, or applying to cancel the registration certificate. Where necessary NMPA may order the MAH to carry out a post-marketing evaluation or organise one directly.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.exceptions: If the MAH fails to carry out a post-marketing evaluation required by NMPA, the registration certificate is not renewed on expiry (Art 28(3)).
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Risk management & minimisation; Safety labeling

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当对已注册药品定期开展上市后评价，对药品的风险和获益进行综合分析评估，根据上市后评价结果，采取修订说明书、提高质量标准、完善生产工艺、暂停生产和销售、实施药品召回、申请注销药品注册证书等措施。必要时，国务院药品监督管理部门可以责令药品上市许可持有人开展上市后评价或者直接组织开展上市后评价。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. No interval stated for "periodically".
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall periodically carry out post-marketing evaluation of registered drugs, conduct a comprehensive analysis and assessment of the risks and benefits of the drug, and, according to the results of the post-marketing evaluation, take measures such as revising the package insert, raising quality standards, improving the production process, suspending production and sale, implementing a drug recall, and applying for cancellation of the drug registration certificate. Where necessary, the drug regulatory department under the State Council may order the drug marketing authorisation holder to carry out post-marketing evaluation or directly organise post-marketing evaluation.

f.title: Strengthen risk management of drugs made before approval and sold after approval
f.statement: MAHs shall strengthen the risk management of drugs manufactured before the drug approval document was obtained and placed on the market under Art 36(1) (commercial-scale batches that passed the relevant GMP compliance inspection, or for new, rare-disease, shortage and other urgently needed drugs, batches made after passing that inspection).
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026. Commercial-scale batches made before approval and released for sale after approval (Art 36(1)).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当加强对依照前款规定上市销售药品的风险管理。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. The scope in the statement paraphrases Art 36(1), which the quote refers to as 前款.
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall strengthen the risk management of drugs marketed and sold in accordance with the preceding paragraph.

f.title: Provide or publish contact details so medical institutions can notify quality problems
f.statement: MAHs and suppliers shall provide or publish an e-mail address, telephone number, fax number or similar contact details so that medical institutions can easily notify them of relevant information (Art 61(1): a medical institution that finds a quality problem with a drug it purchased or used must promptly inform the supplier and the MAH).
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人、供货单位应当提供或者公布电子邮件地址、电话、传真等，方便医疗机构告知相关信息。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. Found during the translation pass. Context from Art 61(1) is given in brackets in the statement and adds no duty for the MAH.
rows.quote_en: Drug marketing authorisation holders and suppliers shall provide or publish an e-mail address, telephone number, fax number, etc., to make it easier for medical institutions to inform them of relevant information.

f.title: Rectify and eliminate safety hazards when authorities impose risk control measures
f.statement: Where drug regulatory departments take risk control measures such as suspending production, sale, use or import under DAL Art 99(3), MAHs, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall rectify and eliminate the safety hazards. The measures are lifted when the department assesses that requirements are met.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.
f.exceptions: Refusal to implement such measures is penalised under Art 85.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: MAH, drug manufacturer, drug distributor (and medical institution)
rows.quote: 药品监督管理部门依照药品管理法第九十九条第三款规定采取暂停生产、销售、使用、进口等风险控制措施的，药品上市许可持有人、药品生产企业、药品经营企业、医疗机构应当进行整改，消除安全隐患。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: Where the drug regulatory department takes risk control measures such as suspending production, sale, use or import in accordance with Article 99(3) of the Drug Administration Law, drug marketing authorisation holders, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall carry out rectification and eliminate potential safety hazards.

f.title: Do not advertise a drug while provincial or national risk control measures apply
f.statement: While provincial or higher drug regulatory departments have such risk control measures in place, the drug concerned shall not be advertised; advertisements already published shall be stopped immediately.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.

rows.actor: MAH and others advertising the drug
rows.quote: 在省级以上人民政府药品监督管理部门采取前款规定的风险控制措施期间，不得发布相关药品的广告；已经发布的，应当立即停止。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. 不得 = shall not. Actor not named; falls on whoever advertises, typically the MAH.
rows.quote_en: During the period in which the drug regulatory department of the people's government at or above the provincial level takes the risk control measures specified in the preceding paragraph, advertisements for the drug concerned shall not be published; those already published shall be stopped immediately.

f.title: Take immediate measures and report a drug safety incident to the county regulator
f.statement: A unit where a drug safety incident occurs shall immediately take measures to prevent the harm from spreading and immediately report it to the county-level drug regulatory department where the incident occurred.
f.applicability: China; Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law (State Council Order No. 828, fourth revision of 16 January 2026), in force from 15 May 2026.

rows.actor: Any unit where a drug safety incident occurs (including MAHs, manufacturers and distributors)
rows.quote: 发生药品安全事件的单位应当立即采取措施防止危害扩大，并立即报告事件发生地县级人民政府药品监督管理部门。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. 立即 has no number, so no deadline_rule. "Drug safety incident" (药品安全事件) is not defined in the text.
rows.quote_en: A unit where a drug safety incident occurs shall immediately take measures to prevent the harm from expanding, and immediately report to the drug regulatory department of the county-level people's government of the place where the incident occurred.

dates.title: PRC DAL Implementing Regulations (State Council Order No. 828): take effect
dates.scope: All parties under the Drug Administration Law in China, including MAHs, sponsors, manufacturers and distributors
dates.quote: 本条例自2026年5月15日起施行。
dates.quote_en: These Regulations shall take effect from 15 May 2026.
dates.timing_note: 施行 = takes effect, so kind effective. Also stated in the promulgating State Council Order No. 828. The adoption date (31 December 2025), signature date (16 January 2026) and web publication date (27 January 2026) are not application dates and are not recorded. No transition period stated.
